page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.s3 server family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs paired with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 1.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance type does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. It lacks integrated GPU hardware accelerators and does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation combined with a low memory-to-vCPU ratio, this server type represents a lean compute-focused configuration. It is designed for workloads that require dedicated processing power but have minimal memory footprints, such as lightweight web serving, basic microservices, and utility computing tasks.
